Additionally, many organizations offer resources on how to protect yourself against unauthorized access to your personal information online. For example, some websites provide tools to help users manage their privacy settings. These services often include options to control who has access to certain types of personal information. You may also want to review terms of service agreements before providing any personal information to third parties. This will give you insight into what kind of information they might collect about you and how they plan to use it. Finally, make sure to read through all privacy policies
